coreProblem: The overwhelming struggle of content creation, writer's block, and the constant pressure of deadlines for businesses and individuals, leading to burnout and suboptimal output.
targetEmotion: Frustration and exhaustion, transitioning to curiosity, relief, and ultimately empowerment and satisfaction.

scenes.name: Hook: Blank Page Despair
scenes.description: Extreme close-up on a laptop screen displaying a blank document titled 'Blog Post Draft.' The cursor blinks relentlessly. A subtle, urgent on-screen text overlay reads 'WRITER'S BLOCK?'.

scenes.name: Frustration: Tired Face
scenes.description: Close-up on the young professional's face (20s-30s). Their eyes are bloodshot and tired, reflecting deep frustration and exhaustion. A slight furrow in their brow. Dim, late-night/early-morning lighting from the laptop screen.

scenes.name: Aggressive Deletion
scenes.description: Tight shot on the character's hands furiously typing a few words, then aggressively hitting the backspace key, deleting everything. The desk is messy with coffee cups and crumpled papers.

scenes.name: Deadline Looms / Defeat
scenes.description: Wider shot of the character at their desk. A calendar notification briefly flashes 'DEADLINE TOMORROW!' on the laptop screen. The character buries their face in their hands, utterly defeated. A subtle on-screen text overlay: 'BRAIN. FRIED.'

scenes.name: A Glimmer of Hope
scenes.description: The character slowly lifts their head, looking defeated. Their eyes scan the screen, then subtly widen as a pop-up ad for 'Jasper AI writing assistant' appears. The pop-up is clean and intriguing, not overly intrusive.

scenes.name: Tentative Click
scenes.description: Close-up of the character's hand hovering over the mouse/trackpad, then tentatively clicking on the 'Jasper AI' pop-up. Their expression shows a mix of skepticism and desperate curiosity.

scenes.name: Jasper in Action: Prompt
scenes.description: A dynamic shot of the Jasper AI interface. The character quickly types a prompt like 'Write a compelling blog post on the benefits of AI content creation' into the input field. The UI is clean and modern.

scenes.name: AI Magic: Instant Generation
scenes.description: The screen fills *instantly* with high-quality, relevant text. Rapid flashes of various content types (e.g., 'Ad Copy,' 'Email Subject,' 'Social Media Caption' templates) briefly appear, emphasizing versatility. On-screen text: 'AI MAGIC 🤯' and 'CONTENT IN SECONDS!'

scenes.name: Awe and Relief
scenes.description: Close-up of the character's face. Their initial skepticism vanishes, replaced by wide-eyed awe, then a deep, relieved smile spreads across their face as they read the generated content on screen.

scenes.name: Content Completed
scenes.description: The screen displays a fully drafted, polished blog post, visually impressive with formatting and clear headings. The character confidently clicks 'publish' or 'send' on the screen, a sense of finality and accomplishment.

scenes.name: Empowerment and CTA
scenes.description: The character leans back in their chair, taking a slow, contented sip of coffee, a genuine, relaxed smile on their face. The screen is subtly visible in the background. Prominent, persistent on-screen text CTA: 'TRY JASPER AI (LINK IN BIO)' with 'Start your 7-day FREE Trial!' below it.

ctaGoal: Drive traffic to Jasper's website for a free trial or demo, encouraging direct sign-ups.
voiceTone: Authentic, relatable, slightly exasperated at first, then transitioning to amazed, excited, and finally confident and empowering.
visualStyle: Raw, documentary-like at first with natural lighting and close-ups on the struggle, then transitioning to bright, clean, and dynamic UI shots for Jasper, ending with a professional, polished look for the final content. Explicit, strategically placed on-screen text for key messages and CTA.
musicPace: Starts with 'dramatic-music' building tension and frustration, transitions to 'upbeat-music' as Jasper is discovered and used, and finishes with 'triumphant-music' for the moment of success and relief.
